title: HORN & SWITCH MOUNTING
summary: RPO UA6 anti-theft alarm, rear of car: the alarm key switch (lock cylinder with escutcheon) in the rear panel between the tail lamp openings, 5.90 from the centerline, held from behind by a retainer; and the separate alarm horn mounted inside the LH rear body. The horn bracket is bolted with a lock washer (100-140 LBS IN) into a plate riveted to the inner panel.

parts.name: LOCK UNIT
parts.name_expanded: Lock unit – anti-theft alarm key switch

fastening.to: plate [8] behind the LH rear inner panel
fastening.note: Bolt [4] with lock washer [5] goes through the horn [6] bracket and the panel's 3/8 hole into plate [8] on the back side.
Rivets [7] through the 13/64 dia holes hold plate [8] behind the panel (View A gives hole locations).

fastening.to: rear panel between the tail lamp openings
fastening.note: View B: lock unit [3] passes through escutcheon [2] and the 1.20 dia hole in the rear panel from outside; retainer [1] clips over it from behind. A production 'LOCK' fastener (no callout, torque 1, 10-14 LBS IN) is shown next to the switch.
